scope.rule: Only explicit m_defined true prefabKey values and subsequent inherited values; all database levels must resolve to the same nonempty key. No suffix inference or downloads.

supplement.license: Game assets copyright Hypergryph; local extraction for research

boundaries: A source key mapping proves asset identity lookup only, not support for every root behavior.
Keep original enemy IDs and their database stats; alias only prefab/animation resource lookup.
Never overwrite a target enemy animation with conflicting alias timing.
Candidate counts mean existing missing assets can be supplied; do not equate them with newly completed enemies.
Missing animation name matches are inventory joins, not proof of a unique single-hit timing contract.
